basics.title: Trading Basics
basics.subtitle: Markets, charts, orders and brokers
basics.description: Start from zero: what a financial market is, how to read charts and timeframes, trading styles, order types, working with a platform, and choosing a broker and an account.

forex.title: Forex and Gold
forex.subtitle: Currency pairs, gold, oil and economic news
forex.description: Everything you need to trade forex: currency pairs, pips and lots, costs and calculations; gold, oil and indices; and fundamental analysis: macroeconomics, the economic calendar and how markets move together.

crypto.title: Crypto
crypto.subtitle: From Bitcoin to futures, DeFi and on-chain
crypto.description: The whole crypto world in one course: Bitcoin and the blockchain, altcoins and exchanges, wallet security, DeFi and its risks, futures, leverage and liquidation, and finally tokenomics, on-chain data and market cycles.

technical.title: Technical Analysis
technical.subtitle: Candles, trends, patterns, Fibonacci and multiple timeframes
technical.description: Learn to read a chart step by step: candlesticks, trend, support and resistance, trendlines and market structure, chart patterns, Fibonacci and multiple-timeframe analysis.

risk.title: Risk and Psychology
risk.subtitle: Surviving in the market
risk.description: Every trader's most important skill: position sizing, the maths of losses and professional risk management; and controlling emotions, mental biases, and building habits and discipline.

indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.subtitle: Moving averages, RSI, MACD, volume and Ichimoku
indicators.description: The most popular analysis tools: moving averages and crossovers, Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD and the Stochastic, divergence, volume and the volume profile, and Ichimoku from its parts to a full strategy.

strategies.title: Trading Strategies
strategies.subtitle: Breakouts, ranges, swing, day trading, scalping and your own system
strategies.description: From analysis to trading: breakout and mean-reversion strategies, swing trading, day trading and scalping, and finally building your own trading system with statistics, backtesting and forward testing.

advanced.title: Advanced Analysis
advanced.subtitle: Price action, supply and demand, smart money, Elliott and harmonics
advanced.description: For when you know the basics: price action and its setups, supply and demand zones, smart money (liquidity, order blocks and FVGs), Dow theory and Elliott waves, and harmonic patterns.
